notes: Built missing Super Marlin INT4 cache successfully, then graph capture failed because Super latent expert dimensions are unsupported by graph replay MoE. Long calibration began but the process exited before benchmark output; kernel log showed an NVIDIA timeout near termination.

Rerun with graph disabled reached benchmark warmup and completed the first 25K prefill warmup after about 9 minutes, then was interrupted at the second fixed 25K warmup. Startup calibration had selected an 8,323-token long probe with 1,974 MB prefill low-water and estimated 38,007 MB scratch at 50K, so the fixed 25K/50K benchmark sizing is not appropriate for Super on this 5090.

Adaptive prefill sizing worked: timed prefill ran at 1K/5K/8,323 and best prefill was 192.8 tok/s at 8,324 tokens. Decode and round-trip were invalid because all benchmark decode prompts hit EOS early before the 50/100/250 token targets.
After benchmark min-new fix, two benchmark wrappers launched concurrently and both failed during startup with CUDA OOM due duplicate Super residency. Invalid measurement; do not use.

Clean single rerun after min-new build and duplicate cleanup. Graph remained disabled because Super latent expert graph replay is unsupported. Benchmark completed: prefill best 192.9 tok/s, internal decode best 21.86 tok/s, network round-trip best 34.85 tok/s, HCS 3358/20480 (16.4%), min free VRAM 5758 MB.
